# Living Space

> Dependency-free spatial UI for real HTML panels. Public source alpha with a GitHub Pages showcase. Not published to npm.

MIT library by Maxence Mauduit. Keep ordinary HTML controls and accessibility. No WebGL, tracking or runtime network requests.

## Public resources
- [Integration guide](agent-guide.md): markup, lifecycle, paths, workspace and limitations.
- [Documentation](documentation/index.html): complete public API and usage.
- [Type declarations](src/strata.d.ts): public contract.
- [Standalone example](examples/basic/index.html): public selection/drag/path, pause, destroy/remount; no demo stylesheet dependency.
- [Adaptive workspace](examples/workspace/index.html): standalone assembly, resizing, native form/focus state and cleanup.
- [Performance](performance/index.html): reproducible local frame measurements and source sizes.
- [Alpha migration and recipes](README.md#practical-integration-recipes): complete public controller, constructor/update boundaries, focus versus modal semantics, layout/assembly and geometry limitations.
- [README](README.md): setup and release commands.
- [License](LICENSE): MIT notice.
- [Asset notices](ASSETS.md): demo artwork and optional fonts.

- [Installation and eye-tracking research](research/index.html): Provider options, interaction hypotheses and validation milestones. Eye tracking is research only; the pointer prototype is not shipped in the playground.

- [Text-first overview](https://mmaxence.github.io/strata/overview.html): product, capabilities, examples and limitations without JavaScript.
- [Full agent reference](https://mmaxence.github.io/strata/llms-full.txt): combined README, integration guidance and TypeScript API.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/mmaxence/strata): MIT runtime and examples.
- [Sitemap](https://mmaxence.github.io/strata/sitemap.xml).

- [Eight practical recipes](examples/recipes/guide.md): choice guide and runnable gallery for consistent selection, focus return, gestures, native/reduced layouts and cleanup; local candidate, not publication evidence.
